record.original_question: Fix k >= 1. Does there exist an integer N(k) such that every non-bipartite graph G in G(m, {C_3, C_5, ..., C_{2k+1}}) with even m >= N(k) satisfies one of the three exact spectral extremal descriptions in Conjecture 2.11, according to the congruence class of m - (2k - 1) modulo 3?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 2.11 (Li and Yu [15], 2023). Let k >= 1. There is an integer N(k). Assume that G is a non-bipartite graph in G(m, {C3, C5, . . . , C2k+1}) with even m >= N(k).
Very recently, Lou, Lu and Zhai [31, Theorem 1.4] confirmed Conjecture 2.11 with m >= 30k+45.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let k ≥ 1 be a fixed integer. For a graph G, let e(G) denote its number of edges (its "size") and let λ(G) denote its spectral radius (the largest eigenvalue of its adjacency matrix). Let G(m, {C_3, C_5, …, C_{2k+1}}) denote the family of simple graphs with exactly m edges that contain no cycle of any odd length 3, 5, …, 2k+1.

For each residue r ∈ {0,1,2}, an explicit family of extremal graphs F_r(m,k) is defined as follows (these are the conjectured spectral-extremal non-bipartite C_{≤2k+1}-odd-free graphs of size m, with structure depending on m − (2k−1) mod 3):
 • F_0(m,k): a graph obtained by taking a complete bipartite graph K_{2,t} and attaching a fixed small odd-edge gadget G_0 so that the total number of edges equals m and the graph has exactly one odd cycle of length 2k+3;
 • F_1(m,k): the analogous construction with gadget G_1;
 • F_2(m,k): the analogous construction with gadget G_2.
(In each case the spectral radius λ(F_r(m,k)) is determined as the largest root of an explicit cubic polynomial whose coefficients are polynomials in m and k.)

Question. Does there exist an integer N(k) such that for every even integer m ≥ N(k) and every non-bipartite graph G ∈ G(m, {C_3, C_5, …, C_{2k+1}}), one has
  λ(G) ≤ λ(F_r(m,k)),
where r ≡ m − (2k − 1) (mod 3), with equality if and only if G is isomorphic to F_r(m,k)?
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work by Lou, Lu and Zhai confirmed the conjecture for all even m ≥ 30k+45, thereby resolving the conjecture (with an explicit threshold N(k) = 30k+45). The conjecture is therefore considered solved.

status_evidence.title: Zhenzhen Lou's research works
status_evidence.snippet: Lou, Lu and Huang/Zhai determined the maximum spectral radius of {C_3, C_5, …, C_{2k+1}}-free non-bipartite graphs of size m and confirmed the conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Lou, Lu and Zhai resolved the Li–Yu conjecture on the spectral extremal non-bipartite graphs avoiding short odd cycles, for sufficiently large even size m.

status_evidence.title: The Maximum Spectral Radius of Non-Bipartite Graphs Forbidding Short Odd Cycles
status_evidence.snippet: Studies maximum spectral radius for non-bipartite {C_3,...,C_{2k+1}}-free graphs and provides extremal characterizations.
status_evidence.claim: The spectral extremal problem for non-bipartite graphs forbidding short odd cycles has been solved in the size-version setting.
